dimension_basis: Owner-directed inch-centered response scenario. Absolute heel/bend/hole datums and delivered tolerances are unknown; this is not a measured product model.
elastic_material_basis: Declared ordinary structural-steel elastic analogy only; actual product elastic properties and steel yield strength are not adopted.
collector: One internal six-coordinate rigid heel collector; condensed with zero external heel load, never clamped to the world.
strip_partition: Two independent half-width rectangular strips per arm, neutral lines at transverse +/-width/4. No longitudinal interstrip continuity is enforced.
selected_holes: Only the far transverse pair on each flange; all eight nominal factory holes retained in the manifest but holes do not reduce this gross response stiffness.
free_tail: The unloaded tail beyond the far port contributes zero elastic strain in this four-port-only scenario; no tail contact or distributed gravity load is included.
scope: Infinitesimal linear elastic strip-network response. No finite objectivity, plate fidelity, response accuracy bound, resistance, complete joint or physical acceptance.

primary_method_documentation.locator: 3D E/G/A/J/Iy/Iz/shear-area parameters; solid rectangular shear area5/6 gross area
primary_method_documentation.scope: Beam-theory background only, not qualification of this four-strip fitting approximation.
